_how: Record a payment with: pnpm exec tsx scripts/add-supporter.ts "Name" <amount>  (or edit this file on GitHub). Every install reads it over the network, so a change here updates the Support & about page and the dashboard card everywhere with no release. totalReceived: the combined total in rupees - convert PayPal/USD yourself and add it in, because the page shows one number. supporters: how many people. people: each named supporter, their combined amount and the date they last gave, newest last. thanks: the same names, kept for installs older than this field. goal: optional target and what it pays for. updated: YYYY-MM-DD. Names go in ONLY with the supporter's permission - use --anonymous otherwise and they are counted without being listed. Anything unexpected in here is ignored rather than shown (see parseSupporters in src/lib/supporters.ts), so a typo cannot break the app.
